listings.title: 1965 Sunbeam Tiger Mk I
listings.description: Midnight Blue originally; refinished current shade in 2007 Canadian refurb. Blue soft top, chrome bumpers, Tiger badges. Scratch on windshield. Offered again by Houston dealer after Aug 2026 BaT. Replacement STOA head noted. Dealer no-reserve, Houston 77074.

listings.title: 28k-Mile 2012 Ford Expedition Limited 4×4
listings.description: 28k-Mile Ingot Silver Metallic Expedition Limited 4×4. Keyless pad, running boards, powered liftgate, receiver hitch. Registered in Washington through July 2026. Humble, TX 77396 no-reserve.

listings.title: 1974 Yamaha TX750
listings.description: Burgundy Wine Flake TX750, 10k miles. Air-cooled 743cc SOHC parallel-twin, five-speed, kick+electric start, pod filters, chrome dual exhaust, wire-spoke wheels, front disc. Oil/carbs/petcock/battery/plugs work under current ownership. Private-party no-reserve, Houston 77062.

listings.title: 306-Powered Factory Five Racing Mk2 Roadster 5-Speed
listings.description: Blue with silver stripes over black vinyl, 9k miles shown. 306ci Ford V8 (Edelbrock heads/intake, Holley 670), Tremec T5 5-speed, 8.8 LSD 3.27. Double roll hoops, side-exit exhaust, Halibrand-style 17s, racing harnesses. Kit 2004 / build 2006 ASVE. Dealer no-reserve, Spring TX 77373.

listings.title: 2016 BMW R1200RT
listings.description: Black bodywork over tubular-steel frame, 21k miles. 1,170cc DOHC opposed-twin, six-speed, enclosed driveshaft. Telelever front, Paralever swingarm, triple Brembo discs w/ABS, Krauser bars, electronically adjustable windscreen. Private-party no-reserve, Cypress TX 77429.

listings.title: 1995 Mercedes-Benz SL500
listings.description: Midnight Blue (904) over gray leather, 54k miles. 5.0 V8, 4-speed automatic. Replacement blue soft top and three top cylinders 2022; body-color hardtop headliner replaced then. 18" Performa 25 wheels, Bose, Bluetooth head unit. Spring, TX 77380 dealer no-reserve.

listings.title: 59k-Kilometer Japanese-Market 1998 Mercedes-Benz E430 Avantgarde Wagon
listings.description: 59k-Kilometer Japanese-market W210 E430 Avantgarde wagon in Brilliant Silver Metallic, imported to the US. Sunroof, roof rails, AMG badge. Spring, TX 77380 dealer no-reserve.

listings.title: 44k-Mile 2005 Jaguar XK8 Convertible
listings.description: 44k-Mile Ebony Black XK8 convertible with matching soft top; soft-top hydraulic hoses replaced Aug 2026. 4.2 V8. Spring, TX 77380 dealer no-reserve.
